``` {r preprocessing}

library(caret)
library(dplyr)
library(fastDummies) 

# read in data
nfl_data <- read.csv(
  "/Users/jroberge/Downloads/nfl_2019.csv", 
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE, 
  na.strings = c("NA", "", "NULL", "-")
)

# remove rows with missing classification data
missing_indices <- which(is.na(nfl_data$pass_length) & is.na(nfl_data$run_location))
nfl_data <- nfl_data[-missing_indices, ]

# one hot encoder for boolean target variable
nfl_data$is_pass <- ifelse(!is.na(nfl_data$run_location), 0, 1)
y_target <- nfl_data$is_pass

# filter to classification features
x_features <- c("posteam", "side_of_field", "shotgun", "no_huddle",
                "yrdln", "down", "goal_to_go", "qtr",
                "game_seconds_remaining", "posteam_score")
x_data <- nfl_data[x_features]

x_data$side_of_field <- ifelse(
  x_data$posteam == x_data$side_of_field,
  "Theirs",
  "Opposing"
)

# one hot encode categorical columns
categ_cols <- c("posteam", "side_of_field", "yrdln", "down")
x_data <- dummy_cols(x_data, select_columns = categ_cols, remove_first_dummy = FALSE)
x_data <- x_data[, !(names(x_data) %in% categ_cols)] 

# normalize continuous features
continuous_cols <- c("game_seconds_remaining", "posteam_score")
x_data[, continuous_cols] <- scale(x_data[, continuous_cols])

# add bias term to create final X matrix
x_data$bias <- 1
X_all <- as.matrix(x_data)
storage.mode(X_all) <- "numeric"

# split data into training and test data
trainIndex <- createDataPartition(y_target, p = .75, list = FALSE, times = 1)
X_train <- X_all[trainIndex,]
X_test <- X_all[-trainIndex,]
y_train <- y_target[trainIndex]
y_train <- as.matrix(y_train)
storage.mode(y_train) <- "numeric"
y_test <- y_target[-trainIndex]
y_test <- as.matrix(y_test)
storage.mode(y_test) <- "numeric"


```


``` {r mlp setup}

eta <- 0.001 # step size
q <- 10 # hidden nodes

n <- nrow(X_train)
d <- ncol(X_train)

W1 <- matrix(rnorm(d * q), nrow = d, ncol = q)
W2 <- matrix(rnorm(q * 1), nrow = q, ncol = 1)

# relu function 
relu <- function(x) {
  matrix(pmax(0, x))
}

# sigmoid function
sigmoid <- function(x) {
  1 / (1 + exp(-x))
}

# loss func = - (y * log(y_pred) + (1-y) * log(1-y_pred))

# gradient descent epochs and error tracking
errors <- numeric()
epochs <- 500

# forward pass func
forward_pass <- function(X, W1, W2) {
  H_net <- X %*% W1          # (n x d) %*% (d x q) = (n x q)
  H_out <- matrix(pmax(0, H_net), nrow = nrow(H_net), ncol = ncol(H_net)) 
  O_net <- H_out %*% W2      # (n x q) %*% (q x 1) = (n x 1)
  Y_pred <- 1 / (1 + exp(-O_net))  # sigmoid
  
  list(Y_pred = Y_pred, H_out = H_out, H_net = H_net)
}

```




``` {r mlp}

# gradient descent loop
for (epoch in 1:epochs) {
  # vectorized to imrpove efficiency
  fwd <- forward_pass(X_train, W1, W2)
  
  # backprop
  delta_2 <- fwd$Y_pred - y_train  # (n x 1)
  dW2 <- t(fwd$H_out) %*% delta_2 / n  # (q x n) %*% (n x 1) = (q x 1)
  
  relu_deriv <- ifelse(fwd$H_net > 0, 1, 0)  # (n x q)
  delta_1 <- (delta_2 %*% t(W2)) * relu_deriv  # (n x 1) %*% (1 x q) * (n x q) = (n x q)
  dW1 <- t(X_train) %*% delta_1 / n  # (d x n) %*% (n x q) = (d x q)
  
  # update
  W2 <- W2 - eta * dW2
  W1 <- W1 - eta * dW1
  
  # loss
  epsilon <- 1e-15 # to prevent log(0) 
  L <- -mean(y_train * log(fwd$Y_pred + epsilon) + (1 - y_train) * log(1 - fwd$Y_pred + epsilon))
  errors <- c(errors, L)

}

# evaluate
fwd_test <- forward_pass(X_test, W1, W2)
y_pred_binary <- ifelse(fwd_test$Y_pred > 0.5, 1, 0)
accuracy <- sum(y_pred_binary == y_test) / length(y_test)
cat("Test Set Accuracy:", accuracy, "\n")

```
